summary.text: Hamilton's Ferrari and Russell's Mercedes had the same race pace within the uncertainty (0.03 ± 0.17 s a lap), with tyre compound and age, fuel burn and traffic taken out.
Russell's Mercedes was not measurably slower than Hamilton's Ferrari in any sector.

Ferrari, Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull Racing had the most grip in fast corners, 2.6–3.9% above the mean team; Cadillac, Williams and Aston Martin had the least, 3.2–4.2% below. In slow corners Mercedes and Ferrari were ahead, 4.1–4.9% above.
